title: LevelsSMP (Remake)
description: A hardcore survival plugin where your multiplier is your life. Steal multipliers from other players to gain more hearts and XP, but be careful dropping to 0.0x results in a deathban.
body:
A hardcore Lifesteal-style plugin where you steal XP multipliers from players to increase your Max Health!

**How It Works:**

 * **The Basics:** Everyone starts at 1.0x (10 hearts). The maximum limit is 6.0x (26 hearts).
 * **Steal Hearts:** Killing a player steals 0.5x from them and gives it to you.
 * **PvE Deaths:** Dying to a mob, lava, or fall damage loses 0.1x.
 * **Deathban:** If your multiplier drops to 0.0x, you are instantly banned from the server!
 * **XP Boost:** Your multiplier also boosts the amount of XP you get from picking up orbs.
 * **Action Bar:** A custom ⭐ action bar always shows your current multiplier at the bottom of your screen.
